per_story.prompt:
Create one polished static factual editorial illustration, landscape 1200x630, high-density advanced textbook quality on pure white, deep teal/amber/graphite. No people, logos, branding, photos, dashboards, generic card grid, faux text, tiny paragraphs. Use only the exact visible labels below, each once and fully legible with 32px safe margins. Rich conceptual cutaway, elegant dimensional technical linework, not measured engineering geometry.

Subject: safe model-provider failover. A self-contained read-only inference can retry through a qualified alternate only if replay is safe, time and shared attempt budget remain, and alternate features, data controls, health and tested capacity qualify. Normal primary path and eligible secondary path are distinct. Partial output or uncertain actions must go to reconciliation rather than blind replay. If neither route qualifies, queue/degrade/stop. Recovery to primary is gradual.

Composition: broad split-route eligibility junction, four meaningful regions; incoming read-only operation top-left; exposed layered sieve center-left shows replay, time and retry-budget controls; two distinct provider lanes upper/right with visible qualification rail; a separate amber reconciliation siding lower-left and no-route outcome lower-right. At least 12 meaningful components. Internal substages visible. Solid primary traffic, dashed conditional alternate, subordinate control lines. Unambiguous relationships; no arrow from uncertain action into secondary. No invented numeric metrics or guaranteed safety.

Exact text allowlist:
"Safe provider failover"
"Read-only request"
"Replay safety"
"Time remaining"
"Shared retry budget"
"Primary route"
"Approved secondary"
"Features and data controls"
"Healthy and load-tested"
"One accepted result"
"Partial or uncertain action"
"Reconcile before restart"
"Queue, degrade or stop"
"Gradual failback"
All text large enough for 1200x630. Show conceptual conditions, not hardware pipes or gears. No extra text.
per_story.correction_notes: Replay safety, deadline and shared budget are exposed in the eligibility sieve. Primary and eligible secondary converge to one result; uncertain actions branch to reconciliation and an ineligible route stops. Gradual failback is a policy brace rather than a result path. Two rejected candidates had an incorrect failback connector and control bypass; the third corrected them. All fourteen labels are readable in the exact saved PNG.

Four major visual regions, 12+ meaningful components, visible internal base-generation and cache-reuse substages. Clear connector direction. "One composed checkpoint"
"Chat base"
"Decision adapter"
"Guardian adapter"
"Speech encoder"
"Shared KV cache"
"Text request"

per_story.correction_notes: Exploded chat base, decision and guardian adapters share the exposed KV cache; the speech encoder supplies transcription separately. Cyan decision output originates at decision adapter, purple safety output at guardian. First draft misattached decision output; corrected second draft also removed simulated writing. All fourteen labels are correct and legible. Geometry is conceptual model composition, not physical GPU architecture.

Subject: a governed enterprise AI knowledge lifecycle. Capture creates knowledge records retaining source and owner. Validate weighs trust signals and escalates stale/conflicting content to expert revalidation. Organize assigns personal/team/company scope. Govern enforces permissions and audit history. Deliver exposes a current answer with provenance. This is a maintained lifecycle, not a database that automatically guarantees truth. Expert revalidation returns to validation; no automatic public sharing.

Composition: five connected ascending knowledge terraces from lower-left to upper-right, each a distinct exposed stage rather than a row of boxes. A recognizable folded knowledge specimen travels across the terraces. Capture has source provenance and owner tabs; Validate exposes trust-signal comparison and a separate expert revalidation loop; Organize has nested scope envelopes; Govern has permission boundary and audit ledger; Deliver shows current answer with attached provenance. At least12 meaningful source-supported elements in four visual regions, two visible validation substages, two subordinate provenance/permission connections. A slim provenance rail travels beneath all terraces. Blank sheets have no fake paragraph strokes.

Exact text allowlist, all once:
"Governed knowledge lifecycle"
"Capture"
"Validate"
"Organize"
"Govern"
"Deliver"
"Source and owner"
"Trust signals"
"Expert revalidation"
"Personal, team, company"
"Permissions"
"Audit trail"
"Current answer"
"Provenance"
No other text or digits. Clearly pair each label to its component; arrows only indicate capture->validate->organize->govern->deliver and expert review returning to validation. Nondirectional associations for provenance and permissions. Layered planar/isometric hybrid, refined explanatory texture without decorative machinery.
per_story.correction_notes: The five terraced stages preserve source/owner provenance; validation includes trust comparison and expert revalidation, organization separates scope and governance exposes permissions/audit. First draft had prohibited avatar symbols, omitted Deliver and duplicate Provenance. The corrected version removes avatars, includes all fourteen unique labels and retains the revalidation loop. Small document glyphs denote records rather than readable prose.

Right: a separate magnifying examination lens for Public scrutiny reached by one outward publication arrow. Lower left: closed confidential compartment, NO arrow carrying its contents to public. Lower right: large plain caution caption, no certification badge. At least12 meaningful conceptual components in four major regions, source-sensitive lens associations, no invented data/charts. "Disclosure terms"
"Redactions"
"Informal pressures"
"Conflicts and funding"

Subject: five recoverable context-management methods. Offload bulky tool output to files and supply short previews; preserve older turns in recoverable history with a summary in active context; skills load only when relevant; noisy research has an isolated context and returns a result; long-term memory uses user-controlled plain Markdown that can survive model changes. Raw evidence remains retrievable. No information magically trains a model, no raw research stream floods active context.

Composition: compact central active-context well, surrounded by five distinct compartments in a radial landscape rather than stacked layers or linear pipeline. Left upper large tool output stored in a file vault, a narrow short-preview bridge feeds center. Left lower older turns archived with recoverable-summary ribbon feeding center. Top right a closed/on-demand skill folio with selective loading link. Right isolated research bay sends just Returned result to center. Bottom long-term memory notebook/plain Markdown foundation linked to active context and an open-ended model-portability brace. Dashed retrieval link center to stored evidence, clearly distinguished from ingestion. At least12 meaningful components across four regions, two visible storage/preview substages, secondary recoverability and portability relationships. Use abstract blank records with single geometric symbols, absolutely no paragraph strokes or code.

Exact visible labels once each:
"Recoverable agent context"
"Active context"
"Large tool output"
"File storage"
"Short preview"
"Older turns"
"Recoverable summary"
"On-demand skills"
"Isolated research"
"Returned result"
"Long-term memory"
"Plain Markdown"
"Retrieve raw evidence"
"Keep memory across models"
No extra labels, digits or text. Correct directional arrows: raw->storage->preview->active; old turns->summary->active; isolated research->returned result->active. No arrow from isolated raw work directly to active context. Fine disciplined causal geometry, sophisticated but readable.
per_story.correction_notes: Radial active context receives previews, recoverable summaries, selectively loaded skills and isolated-work results; raw evidence remains retrievable and plain-file long-term memory supports model portability. First draft included paragraph-like strokes and overly textured surfaces; second draft removes all faux writing and preserves fourteen labels. Subject: a bounded release-note Agent Skill. A named procedure has name/description metadata and manual selection. Publishing remains a separate human-controlled boundary; never automatically push tags. Do not imply loading approval authorizes publication.

Composition: left third an orthogonal permissions lattice with three clearly distinct gates Allow/Ask/Deny associated with skill discovery and name/description; blocked Deny ends visibly, Ask has abstract approval hinge, no humanoid icon. Center an open read-only evidence workbench with two substages: merged-PR evidence alongside drafted release notes, then a comparison lens; version proposal and copyable command sit as inspectable output slips, not real code. Right a prominent vertical gold publishing boundary preceded by a separate abstract Human approval gate. Procedure outputs STOP BEFORE boundary. No arrow executes tag push. Bottom boundary caption "No automatic tag push". Four major regions, at least12 meaningful components and two evidence/control side links. Use blank folded documents with one simple geometric content symbol, not text-like strokes or code.

"Permission-bounded release skill"
"Skill discovery"
"Name and description"
"Manual selection"
"Read merged PRs"
"Draft release notes"
"Propose version"
"Compare with evidence"

per_story.correction_notes: Permission lattice separates Allow/Ask/Deny skill loading from a read-only evidence-comparison bench and a separate human publishing decision.
